en: The image is a vintage black-and-white postcard depicting a small alpine village set in a hilly, forested landscape. The village consists of scattered buildings, including farmhouses and a church with a prominent steeple, surrounded by terraced fields and bordered by dense woods. The caption at the bottom of the postcard reads 'Ruffrè (m. 1175) - Val di Non'.
